scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && pnpm --filter @release-relay/core build && pnpm --filter @release-relay/coverage-oracle build
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm --filter @release-relay/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @release-relay/coverage-oracle typecheck
